fees.label: pump.fun trading fee
fees.plain: 0.95% of the SOL → $KIBBLE swap, charged once on the first leg (pump.fun charges protocol fees on the first leg of a multi-hop route). About half funds pump.fun's buyback.

fees.label: Creator fee
fees.plain: 0.3% of the $KIBBLE → $SIMP swap, charged on the last leg and paid into your own coin's creator rewards (you are the creator). $KIBBLE's creator fee is not charged on this route.

fees.label: Liquidity fee
fees.plain: 0% while your coin trades on its bonding curve.

fees.label: Slippage limit
fees.plain: The SOL → $KIBBLE price can move before your transaction lands. Your limit is 3%: if you would get less than the minimum, the whole launch fails and nothing is swapped (Solana still keeps the network + priority fee).

fees.label: Network fee
fees.plain: Solana's base fee: 2 signatures × 0.000005 SOL (your wallet + the new coin's address).

fees.label: Priority fee
fees.plain: 450,000 compute units × 0.1 lamports, so validators pick it up quickly.

fees.label: Account deposits (rent)
fees.plain: One-time Solana storage deposits for your coin's mint, metadata, bonding curve and your token accounts. pump.fun charges no separate create fee.

notes: Charity routing isn't available for $KIBBLE-paired coins.
